entries.question: Which scikit-learn version produced Table 3? The paper does not state it (August 2017 suggests 0.19.x).
entries.resolution: Modern scikit-learn pinned at archaeology time and recorded in requirements.lock; drift absorbed by preregistered tolerances. Any claim that fails only because of version drift is reported as-is.

entries.question: Are pixel values fed raw (0-255) or scaled? The paper describes the data format but not the preprocessing for Table 3.
entries.resolution: Scaled to [0,1] by dividing by 255, the conventional choice; recorded as an explicit config key so an adaptive round can flip it.

entries.question: LogisticRegression multi_class=ovr semantics: modern scikit-learn removed the multi_class parameter and defaults to multinomial.
entries.resolution: Default multinomial used; difference historically within ~0.01 accuracy on this dataset; tolerance set accordingly.

entries.question: The five training-data shuffles have no stated seeds.
entries.resolution: Seeds fixed in the preregistration; the claim is about the mean over shuffles, so exact seeds should not matter beyond run-to-run noise.

entries.question: Perceptron iteration count: the 2017-era default was 5 epochs; modern default is max_iter=1000 with tol-based stopping.
entries.resolution: Modern defaults used; Perceptron is the highest-variance model in the set, so its preregistered tolerance is the widest.
